remarks: This Spacious 3rd floor end unit offers private views from the corner deck/balcony, lots of windows with natural sunlight throughout the day. It has an open concept living and dining room with 9 foot ceilings, kitchen with granite counters, ss appliances and breakfast bar, in-unit washer/dryer. The large bedroom features a huge walk in closet and sliders leading to the private balcony/deck. Renovated bathroom with newer vanity, mirror and light fixture. Updates include new dishwasher, refrigerator, washer, dryer and new air conditioning!! The unit comes with 2 unassigned parking spaces. Move-in fee $100. This modern elevator building has secured entry and is conveniently located in the heart of SONO. Within walking distance to Washington Street, restaurants, access to the Maritime Center, walk to trains and shopping. Building has common area patio, picnic tables and grill. Good credit a must!
